verdict.rationale: Ardent documents a public REST API for CI systems, platforms, dashboards and agent workflows, with role-based token authentication and concrete /v1 connector endpoints. Programmatic control of the API is evidenced. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, and the cited API endpoints cover only connector operations, so full coverage of the product's functionality through the API is not shown. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, API endpoint evidence for core branch create/delete operations, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the API when you are building CI systems, internal developer platforms, custom dashboards, or agent workflows.
Lock deletion | POST /v1/connectors/{connector_id}/deletion-lock | Blocks deletes until unlocked
Release quarantine | POST /v1/connectors/{connector_id}/quarantine/{quarantine_id}/release | Resumes a paused deployment
